intent: An expanding topic field with removable tags, comma and paste parsing, duplicate handling and a visible limit for content and knowledge tools.

layout.direction: A roomy wrap-first text field with fitted topic chips, small remove keys and a lightweight count. Keep field focus after removal.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: 150ms press response; 240ms state changes. No ambient loops.
motion.reduced: Remove transforms and layout motion; keep opacity at 120ms or less.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum additions; existing host tags are never silently removed.

props.name: onChange
props.description: New tag array after additions and removals.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
